items.source: The BeanOverrideProcessor implementation to use.
items.translation: 要使用的 `BeanOverrideProcessor` 实现。

items.source: For concrete examples of such composed annotations, see @TestBean, @MockitoBean, and @MockitoSpyBean.
items.translation: 有关此类组合注解的具体示例，请参阅 @TestBean、@MockitoBean 以及 @MockitoSpyBean。

items.source: Since the composed annotation will typically only be applied to non-static fields, it is expected that the composed annotation is meta-annotated with @Target(ElementType.FIELD). However, certain bean override annotations may be declared with an additional ElementType.TYPE target for use at the type level, as is the case for @MockitoBean which can be declared on a field, test class, or test interface.
items.translation: 由于组合注解通常仅应用于非静态字段，因此预期该组合注解会带有 `@Target(ElementType.FIELD)` 元注解。然而，某些 Bean 覆盖注解可能会声明额外的 `ElementType.TYPE` 目标以在类型级别使用，例如 `@MockitoBean`，它可以应用于字段、测试类或测试接口。

items.source: Specifying this annotation registers the configured BeanOverrideProcessor which must be capable of handling the composed annotation and its attributes.
items.translation: 指定此注解会注册已配置的BeanOverrideProcessor，该处理器必须能够处理组合注解及其属性。
